_comment: Behaviour checks for the openelis-qa plugin. Each eval is a prompt and what a correct session does. Several come from real mistakes in the QA project (2026-08 to 2026-11); the source is named. Run them by hand or with a skill eval runner after changing the plugin, and add one when a new mistake is found.

evals.prompt: Run a smoke test on https://testing.openelis-global.org and tell me how it looks.
evals.expected_output: Loads qa-run. Reads claude/qa-testing-servers.md, records target identity (host, deployed commit, flags), runs the Data Census before any E2E, runs login, Chain A and Y-RECON plus the heuristic pass, grades by maturity not pass count, says which substrate produced each result (sandbox by default for a remote server), and updates the QA tracker with the rev named.

evals.prompt: We just deployed to https://uat.openelis-global.org. Run a regression on the test catalog and create Jira tickets if anything is broken.
evals.expected_output: Runs the regression but does NOT create tickets on its own: standing rule 1 needs Casey to name each finding. Writes a filing card per confirmed finding (2 of 3, one in the UI), runs the finding-skeptic agent, and presents the cards with a recommendation each. If asked to file one, the description ends with a complete QA checks section and the automated-qa label (the hook refuses otherwise).

evals.prompt: On testing, AMR case dates show a day early when I'm in Seattle. File it for Piotr.
evals.expected_output: Does not file. Ruling R-01: app time follows the server time zone and is never a bug (Casey, 2 Nov 2026); an admin time zone setting is designed. Says so in one or two lines, citing the ruling. Source: AMR V2 finding A1.

evals.prompt: The pathology case view loses the block number when I save. Should we file it?
evals.expected_output: No ticket: ruling R-10, pathology, IHC and cytology findings go to the redesign (OGC-264). Offers to add it to the redesign handoff (qa-handoff design handoff). Confirms the behaviour first if it is going into the handoff.

evals.prompt: The weekly CI digest says NO NEW FAILURES but the counts are all zero. Are we good to release?
evals.expected_output: No. Zero suites is NO RESULTS, a broken run, not a green one (QA #229). Points at the 'Wait for the stack to be healthy' step of the run, does not mark the release card GO, and notes the verdict is Casey's call.

evals.prompt: Update the QA tracker with what we did today.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Artifact tool: reads https://claude.ai/artifact/P6HYxRu9vUvfAoXMETKN2h in full, edits in place (stamp, calls, release card never archived, one round card, keep three, archive the oldest), publishes with the same url and omits capabilities, merges on a refused publish, adds a line to claude/qa-tracker.md. Does not look for mcp__cowork tools (the old skill's steps, which failed silently in Sep to Oct).

evals.prompt: What new work came in that we can test?
evals.expected_output: Loads qa-checkin. Finds the last tested develop commit from the latest session doc, lists commits and PRs since then mapped to tickets, checks which server carries each merge commit, and presents a short plan table before long work. Verifies from the diff, closes verified tickets with evidence comments (qa-close), lists new problems as filing cards (not filed), flips fixed tripwires to guards in one QA PR merged with gh on Casey's Mac, updates the tracker and writes a check-in session doc.

evals.prompt: OGC-1588 passes now on my local stack. Close it.
evals.expected_output: Checks every item in the ticket, not only the headline, and whether testing carries the fix. Writes the evidence comment first (server, commit, PR, items, specs, data used; says local stack only if testing has not deployed it), then transitions to Done after reading the available transitions. Records the comment id in the session doc and tracker.

evals.prompt: Run the analyser harness specs against the analyser stack PR heads.
evals.expected_output: Recognises these need a local stack (mock, Bridge, database from CI images), which the cloud sandbox cannot pull, so the step runs on Casey's Mac via Control your Mac with nohup and short polls, or says plainly it is blocked if the Mac is not reachable. Does not report the specs as passed or skipped silently.

evals.prompt: I ran a suite and three cases hit HTTP 500 on endpoints that exist, and one page 404s because the module isn't deployed on this build. How do I record these?
evals.expected_output: The three 500s are FAIL: a 5xx from an endpoint that exists is never GAP. The undeployed module is a GAP with a stated reason and what would retire it, after the feature-presence preflight confirms it is the wrong build rather than missing work.

evals.prompt: Commit everything in the QA repo and push it.
evals.expected_output: Stages files by name, never git add -A or git add . (the repo is public and .auth/ holds live session cookies); the git guard hook refuses the broad forms. Runs the gates including npm run check:plugin before the PR.

evals.prompt: Here's the filing card for the F6 finding: the Workload KPI is impossible to reconcile with the TAT report. File it High.
evals.expected_output: Challenges the claim before filing: 'impossible' needs evidence for every case; the 1 Nov correction comment on OGC-1592 changed it to 'hard to reconcile'. Runs finding-skeptic, narrows the wording and justifies severity by impact, then asks Casey before creating.
